title: Snacks Galore
description: Rows of colorful snacks and dried foods fill the shelves of an Aji Ichiban store in Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong. Francesca Forquet snapped this photo in December 2012, as she became acquainted with the city—"its density, its complexity, and the constant feeling of not knowing what I would find around the next corner," she tells National Geographic.
